instruction:
Fix `packages/excalidraw/actions/actionProperties.test.tsx` for these problems, changing only what they need, following the conventions in the shared brief:
1. Gate 3 revise, the person's words: "U21 never landed: packages/excalidraw/actions/actionProperties.test.tsx is unchanged, so AC-4 (the size control showing and hiding, a click updating the selected elements, undo and redo), AC-8 (arrow-to-arrow paste styles, including clearing the size) and the panel part of AC-5 have no test." Add U21's tests (briefs/U21.md) as a new `describe("arrowhead size", ...)` inside the existing `describe("element locking", ...)`, before its final `});`, reusing the file's existing beforeEach (`await render(<Excalidraw />);`). Do not change existing tests.

WHY EVERY EARLIER ATTEMPT FAILED (verified by the orchestrator in a scratch test with this file's exact render): (1) `UI.createElement("arrow")` without a size leaves the arrow mid-draw (appState.multiElement/newElement set), which blocks undo. (2) This file renders `<Excalidraw />` WITHOUT handleKeyboardGlobally, so `Keyboard.undo()` / `Keyboard.redo()` do NOTHING here (the value stays 1.5). Do not use Keyboard.undo/redo. (3) `API.executeAction(actionChangeArrowheadSize)` passes no value and trips the action's invariant. (4) `actionUndo`/`actionRedo` are not exported (only createUndoAction); do not import them.

VERIFIED WORKING SNIPPETS (every line passed in the scratch test under `render(<Excalidraw />)`). Add these imports: `import { act } from "@testing-library/react";` (merge into the existing @testing-library/react import), `import { actionChangeArrowheadSize } from "./actionProperties";`, `import { actionCopyStyles, actionPasteStyles } from "./actionStyles";`, and `const { h } = window;` at module level.
- Finished, selected arrow: `const arrow = UI.createElement("arrow", { x: 0, y: 0, size: 100 });` (use a different x/y for each further arrow; the newest one created is selected).
- Control shown/hidden: `UI.createElement("line", { x: 0, y: 0, size: 100 });` then `expect(queryByTestId(document.body, "arrowhead-size-large")).toBe(null);` (a line has no heads); after `UI.createElement("arrow", { x: 0, y: 200, size: 100 });` expect it not null.
- Click updates the selection: `fireEvent.click(queryByTestId(document.body, "arrowhead-size-large")!);` then `expect(API.getElement(arrow).arrowheadSize).toBe(1.5);`.
- Change with a value, not via the button: `act(() => { h.app.actionManager.executeAction(actionChangeArrowheadSize, "ui", 1.5); });`.
- Undo/redo: `act(() => { h.app.actionManager.executeAction((h.app.actionManager as any).actions.undo, "ui"); });` then `expect(API.getElement(arrow).arrowheadSize).toBeUndefined(); expect("arrowheadSize" in API.getElement(arrow)).toBe(false);`; `act(() => { h.app.actionManager.executeAction((h.app.actionManager as any).actions.redo, "ui"); });` then expect 1.5.
- Paste styles, arrow to arrow (AC-8). (a): `const src = UI.createElement("arrow", { x: 0, y: 0, size: 100 });` then set 1.5 with the act/executeAction line, `const tgt = UI.createElement("arrow", { x: 0, y: 200, size: 100 });`, `API.setSelectedElements([API.getElement(src)]); API.executeAction(actionCopyStyles); API.setSelectedElements([API.getElement(tgt)]); API.executeAction(actionPasteStyles);` then expect tgt 1.5. (b): `src2` with no size, then `tgt2` created and set to 0.5 with the action (tgt2 is selected), copy from src2, paste onto tgt2, then expect `API.getElement(tgt2).arrowheadSize` undefined and `"arrowheadSize" in API.getElement(tgt2)` false.
- New elements have no key (AC-5 panel part): right after `UI.createElement("arrow", { x: 0, y: 0, size: 100 })`, expect `"arrowheadSize" in API.getElement(arrow)` false and `queryByTestId(document.body, "arrowhead-size-medium")` checked (`toBeChecked()`).
Use `API.getElement(x)` for fresh reads, cast to ExcalidrawLinearElement where TypeScript needs it (`import type { ExcalidrawLinearElement } from "@excalidraw/element/types";`), and keep eslint (--max-warnings=0) and prettier clean.

The file's current text is under Inputs, marked "current text"; your edits apply to exactly that text.
